verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Kintsugi as a US-style sales tax compliance engine (nexus tracking, tax calculation, registrations, filings, credit notes) but contains no mention of VAT-specific invoice fields, registration numbers appearing on invoices, locale invoice formatting rules, or actual invoice document generation/passthrough. Nothing in the docs addresses compliant invoicing (VAT ID display, sequential numbering, reverse-charge text, etc.).
